_variants: Two renders per hero. `painterly` carries the TUNED klein prefix verbatim — it took many iterations to get art worth keeping, so it is not rewritten. `plain` drops the medium word because image-to-3D reconstructs better from render-like inputs. The A/B answers whether style helps or hurts the mesh.
_pose: A-pose at 45 degrees, not T-pose. Closer to the bind pose in docs/specs/rig.mjs (upperArm offset [0,-0.28,0], straight down), and arms flat at the sides would merge with the torso silhouette — reconstruction fuses them into the body.
_background: Chroma green because nothing any hero wears is green. Black failed: navy leggings and black boots vanish into it, rembg kept only the glowing blade, and TRELLIS returned a mesh of the sword.
_weapons: Every hero renders empty-handed. Weapons are separate generations mounted at socket.weapon — docs/specs/rig.mjs requires a distinct mesh per item, and a fused weapon skins to whatever bone the auto-rigger guesses.
